product.schneider-pc2640-2.summary: The EGA AT version that expanded the PC2640 to 1 MB RAM and a 60 MB disk.
product.schneider-pc2640-2.history: The June 1988 German list offered the PC2640/2 alongside the PC2640 for DM 5,261 net with a monochrome monitor or DM 6,139 with a colour EGA monitor.
product.schneider-pc2640-2.technical.con: The disk and RAM distinguished this configuration. The list keeps the 12.5 MHz 80286 and raises RAM from 640 KB to 1 MB and disk capacity from 32 to 60 MB.
product.schneider-pc2640-2.technical.ver: The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-pc2640-2.technical.lim: The board still needs to be matched, an attributable BIOS needs preservation and an image with clear publication rights remains pending.
product.schneider-pc2640-2.technical.sou: CC SELLER / BC, Schneider Computer, 06/1988, p. 2
